The film implies an animal death. Staging keeps it off screen, but the fall and thrashing (70.62 to 73.7) must stay comic-book broad, not distressing: dust and lettering, no close up of the animal's face while she is down.
S11 shows the camel in the dream standing near the king although the real camel is tethered at x 170; this is deliberate dream geography and is why the scene is under the wash.
